attr.title: Tamatama
attr.desc: Plays the Tamagotchi games for Android that you own (Tamagotchi Classic, Classic 2, L.i.f.e. and Angel) with a controller: the directions move a pointer between the buttons on screen, and A, B and C of the device are on the face buttons.
attr.inst: Copy the original .apk files of the games into ports/tamatama/apk/. When you start the port, choose the version in the menu.
